name: cloud-drive-desktop
description: Windows desktop client for Cloud Drive
author: m44882398-prog

scripts.dev: concurrently -k "vite --config vite.config.ts --host 127.0.0.1" "tsc -p tsconfig.json --watch" "wait-on tcp:5173 build/main/index.js && cross-env DESKTOP_RENDERER_URL=http://127.0.0.1:5173 electron ."
scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.json && vite build --config vite.config.ts && electron-builder
scripts.pack: tsc -p tsconfig.json && vite build --config vite.config.ts && electron-builder --dir
